beats.ask: Write the beats of Chapter 2 of this book, following `.claude/skills/chapter-beats/SKILL.md` as the Story Specialist. If the chapter has prose, find the beats in it as it stands: each beat starts at a paragraph, and its Starts line names the scene and copies the first words of that paragraph exactly. Never change the prose. If the chapter has no prose yet, plan its beats from what Kyle says the chapter should do, each with a Starts line naming the scene it belongs in and no words. If the chapter already has a beats note, move it to the book's Archive folder first with a line saying why (never delete it), then write the new one.
